mapper.select:
SELECT a.ExitDate AS statDate, a.ShiftID AS shiftId, a.OperatorID AS operatorId, (SELECT OperatorName FROM dbtoms.tboperatorinfo WHERE a.OperatorID = OperatorID ORDER BY LastUpdateTime DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS operatorName, a.LaneID AS laneId, a.CardID AS cardId, a.VehicleLicense AS licensePlate, a.ExitTime AS tradeTime, (SELECT VehicleName FROM dbtoms.tbvehicleclass WHERE a.PVehicleClass = VehicleClass) AS beginVehicleClass, (SELECT VehicleName FROM dbtoms.tbvehicleclass WHERE a.RVehicleClass = VehicleClass) AS entryVehicleClass, (SELECT VehicleName FROM dbtoms.tbvehicleclass WHERE a.VehicleClass = VehicleClass) AS tradeVehicleClass, CAST(IFNULL(a.toll/100, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS toll FROM ${tableName} a
AND a.CancelFlag = 0 AND a.PVehicleClass != a.VehicleClass
AND a.PVehicleClass IN (1,2,3,4,11,12,13,14,15,16,21,22,23,24,25,26)
AND a.PVehicleClass IN (1,2,3,4)
AND a.PVehicleClass IN (11,12,13,14,15,16)
AND a.PVehicleClass IN (21,22,23,24,25,26)
AND a.VehicleClass IN (1,2,3,4,11,12,13,14,15,16,21,22,23,24,25,26)
AND a.VehicleClass IN (1,2,3,4)
AND a.VehicleClass IN (11,12,13,14,15,16)
AND a.VehicleClass IN (21,22,23,24,25,26)
AND a.StationID = #{stationId}
AND a.ExitDate >= #{intBeginTime}
AND a.ExitDate <= #{intEndTime}
ORDER BY a.ExitDate

SELECT a.ExitDate AS statDate, (SELECT StationName FROM dbtoms.tbstationinfo WHERE a.StationID = StationID LIMIT 1 ) AS StationName, a.ShiftID AS shiftId, a.OperatorID AS operatorId, (SELECT OperatorName FROM dbtoms.tboperatorinfo WHERE a.OperatorID = OperatorID ORDER BY LastUpdateTime DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS operatorName, a.LaneID AS laneId, a.CardID AS cardId, a.VehicleLicense AS licensePlate, a.ExitTime AS tradeTime, (SELECT VehicleName FROM dbtoms.tbvehicleclass WHERE a.PVehicleClass = VehicleClass) AS beginVehicleClass, (SELECT VehicleName FROM dbtoms.tbvehicleclass WHERE a.RVehicleClass = VehicleClass) AS entryVehicleClass, (SELECT VehicleName FROM dbtoms.tbvehicleclass WHERE a.VehicleClass = VehicleClass) AS tradeVehicleClass, IFNULL(a.toll/ 100, 0) AS toll FROM ${tableName} a
AND a.CancelFlag = 0 AND a.PVehicleClass != a.VehicleClass
AND a.PVehicleClass IN (1,2,3,4,11,12,13,14,15,16,21,22,23,24,25,26)
AND a.PVehicleClass IN (1,2,3,4)
AND a.PVehicleClass IN (11,12,13,14,15,16)
AND a.PVehicleClass IN (21,22,23,24,25,26)
AND a.VehicleClass IN (1,2,3,4,11,12,13,14,15,16,21,22,23,24,25,26)
AND a.VehicleClass IN (1,2,3,4)
AND a.VehicleClass IN (11,12,13,14,15,16)
AND a.VehicleClass IN (21,22,23,24,25,26)
AND StationID in
#{stationId}
AND a.ExitDate = #{intBeginTime}
ORDER BY a.ExitDate
